findings.passage: The Republican proposal would also interfere in state elections with a poison pill 'SAVE Act' provision that would disenfranchise eligible voters and erect new barriers to accessing the voting booth.
findings.note: Press release issued in his name, about a Senate stock-trading bill that had SAVE Act proof-of-citizenship/voter ID language attached. The release text describes the provision as a barrier to voting. The release's own summary line also refers to 'unrelated voter suppression provisions'.
